# SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURES — NOT REAL CADICA DATA

Generated by `scripts/prepare_data.py --make-synthetic-fixtures`.

Tiny (32x32) random-noise placeholder frames and made-up bounding boxes, laid out to mirror the real CADICA folder structure (`pX/vY/input/`, `pX/vY/groundtruth/`) purely so `prepare_data.py` and later pipeline phases can be tested end-to-end without the real dataset. Do not use for anything clinical or diagnostic.
